svg.title: The seating lemma gives the required interior margins in translated reflection chambers. Replica itineraries preserve those margins; within a replica original spacing persists and between replicas distances diverge. At sufficiently large displacement and then fine regulator all lattice separations exceed their chamber scales. At the 2h occurrences use adjoints on alternating even positions and unchanged fields on odd positions. Adjoints preserve allowances.
